instruction: Drag the verb 是 (to be) into each gap.

items.translation_en: I am a student.
He is my brother.
She is a teacher.
We are friends.

instruction: Drag the verb 有 (to have) into each gap.

items.translation_en: I have a cat.
He has two children.
Do you have time?
We have many books.

instruction: Drag the correct personal pronoun into each gap.

items.translation_en: My name is Anna.
He is Chinese.
She lives in Beijing.
We study together.

instruction: Drag the correct measure word into each gap.

items.translation_en: one person
two books
three cats
four apples

instruction: Drag the correct number or word into each gap.

items.translation_en: I am twenty years old.
Today is Monday.
There are four people in my family.
I live on the third floor.

instruction: Drag 不 or 没 into each gap.

items.translation_en: I am not a student.
He does not go to school.
items.translation_es: Él no va a la escuela.

items.translation_en: I do not have an older brother.
Yesterday he did not come.

instruction: Drag the question particle 吗 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Are you a student?
Does he have a book?
How are you?
Is that your dog?

instruction: Drag the correct question word into each gap.

items.translation_en: What is your name?
Who is he?
Where do you live?
What time is it now?

instruction: Drag 的 into each gap to show possession.

items.translation_en: This is my book.
His mother is a teacher.
Chinese tea is very good.
items.translation_es: El té chino está muy rico.

items.translation_en: That book is the teacher's.

instruction: Drag 很 before the adjective in each gap.

items.translation_en: I am very happy.
This apple is very big.
He is very busy.
Today it is very cold.

instruction: Drag the correct time word into each gap.

items.translation_en: Today I go to school.
Tomorrow is my birthday.
Yesterday he was not at home.
items.translation_es: Ayer él no estaba en casa.

items.translation_en: I get up at six in the morning.
items.translation_es: Me levanto a las seis de la mañana.

instruction: Drag 在 into each gap.

items.translation_en: I am at home.
He studies at school.
The cat is on the table.
items.translation_es: El gato está sobre la mesa.

items.translation_en: We play in the park.

instruction: Drag 这 or 那 into each gap.

items.translation_en: This is my book.
That is his car.
This apple is very red.
That person is my teacher.

instruction: Drag 会 or 能 into each gap.

items.translation_en: I can speak Chinese.
He can swim.
Can you help me?
It may rain today.

instruction: Drag 想 or 要 into each gap.

items.translation_en: I want to drink water.
He wants to buy a book.
What do you want to eat?
We want to go to China.

instruction: Drag the missing day of the week into each gap.

items.translation_en: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday
Today is Thursday, tomorrow is Friday.
items.translation_es: Hoy es jueves, mañana es viernes.

items.translation_en: I do not work on Sunday.
On Saturday we go to the park.

instruction: Drag 也 or 都 into each gap.

items.sentence: 我是学生，他 ___ 是学生。
items.translation_en: I am a student and he is a student too.
items.translation_es: Yo soy estudiante y él también.

items.translation_en: We are all Chinese.

items.sentence: 我喜欢茶，他 ___ 喜欢茶。
items.translation_en: I like tea and he likes tea too.
items.translation_es: Me gusta el té y a él también.

items.translation_en: They have all come.

instruction: Drag 请 into each gap to make a polite request.

items.translation_en: Please help me.
Please come in.
Please sit down.
Please wait a moment.

instruction: Drag the correct measure word for people into each gap.

items.translation_en: I have three friends.
one teacher (polite)
two students
That doctor is very good.

instruction: Drag 呢 or 吧 into each gap.

items.translation_en: I am fine, and you?
Let's go, shall we?
And him?
See you tomorrow then.

instruction: Drag 了 into each gap for a completed action.

items.translation_en: I have eaten.
He bought a book.
Yesterday I went to school.
We watched a film.

instruction: Drag the correct form with 过 into each gap.

items.translation_en: I have been to Beijing.
Have you eaten Chinese food?
He has seen that film.
We have been to the Great Wall.
items.translation_es: Hemos estado en la Gran Muralla.

instruction: Drag 正在 or 在 into each gap.

items.translation_en: He is eating right now.
I am reading.
They are singing right now.
Mum is cooking.

instruction: Drag 得 into each gap before the degree complement.

items.translation_en: He runs very fast.
She speaks very well.
You write very beautifully.
We had a lot of fun.

instruction: Drag 比 into each gap for comparison.

items.translation_en: I am taller than him.
Today is colder than yesterday.
items.translation_es: Hoy hace más frío que ayer.

items.translation_en: My books are more than yours.
items.translation_es: Mis libros son más que los tuyos.

items.translation_en: He runs faster than me.
items.translation_es: Él corre más rápido que yo.

instruction: Drag 跟 into each gap for 跟…一样.

items.translation_en: I am as tall as you.
This one is the same as that one.
He is the same age as me.
items.translation_es: Él tiene la misma edad que yo.

items.sentence: 我的车 ___ 你的车一样新。
items.translation_en: My car is as new as yours.
items.translation_es: Mi coche es tan nuevo como el tuyo.

instruction: Drag 因为 or 所以 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Because it rained, I did not go.

items.sentence: 因为太冷，___ 我们没出门。
items.translation_en: Because it was too cold, we did not go out.
items.translation_es: Como hacía mucho frío, no salimos.

items.translation_en: He did not come because he was ill.

items.sentence: 因为他努力，___ 成功了。
items.translation_en: Because he worked hard, he succeeded.

instruction: Drag 虽然 or 但是 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Although I am tired, I am happy.

items.sentence: 虽然下雨，___ 我们还是去了。
items.translation_en: Although it rained, we still went.
Although he is not tall, he runs fast.
items.translation_es: Aunque no es alto, corre rápido.

items.translation_en: Although it was expensive, I bought it.

instruction: Drag 如果 or 就 into each gap.

items.sentence: ___ 明天晴天，我们就去公园。
items.translation_en: If it is sunny tomorrow, we will go to the park.
items.translation_es: Si mañana hace sol, iremos al parque.

items.sentence: 如果你来，我 ___ 很高兴。
items.translation_en: If you come, I will be very happy.

items.sentence: ___ 你有时间，就给我打电话。
items.translation_en: If you have time, call me.

items.sentence: 如果他来，我们 ___ 开始。
items.translation_en: If he comes, we will start.

instruction: Drag 着 into each gap for a continuing state.

items.translation_en: The door is open.
He reads while sitting.
A picture hangs on the wall.
items.translation_es: Un cuadro cuelga de la pared.

items.translation_en: She says it smiling.

instruction: Drag the correct result complement into each gap.

items.translation_en: I have finished eating.
I saw him.
I heard it.
He has finished his homework.

instruction: Drag the sentence-final 了 into each gap.

items.translation_en: It is raining now.
He has become ill.
I am twenty now.
It is time to go.

instruction: Drag 还没 into each gap.

items.translation_en: I have not eaten yet.
He has not come yet.
We have not decided yet.
Have you not finished reading yet?

instruction: Drag 要 into each gap for a future action with 了.

items.translation_en: It is going to rain.
We are about to leave.
The train is about to leave.
items.translation_es: El tren está a punto de salir.

items.translation_en: He is about to arrive.
items.translation_es: Él está a punto de llegar.

instruction: Drag 一边 into each gap.

items.sentence: 他 ___ 吃饭，一边看电视。
items.translation_en: He watches TV while eating.
I listen to music while walking.
She dances while singing.
We drink tea while chatting.

instruction: Drag 越 into each gap.

items.translation_en: The more you learn, the more interesting it is.
items.translation_es: Cuanto más aprendes, más interesante es.

items.translation_en: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.
items.translation_es: El tiempo es cada vez más caluroso.

items.translation_en: The more he runs, the faster he gets.
items.translation_es: Cuanto más corre, más rápido va.

items.translation_en: The more we talk, the happier we are.
items.translation_es: Cuanto más hablamos, más contentos estamos.

instruction: Drag 除了 or 以外 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Everyone came except him.
I like everything except you.
Besides Chinese, he also knows English.
items.translation_es: Además del chino, también sabe inglés.

items.translation_en: Besides tea, I also like coffee.
items.translation_es: Además del té, también me gusta el café.

instruction: Drag 只要 or 就 into each gap.

items.translation_en: As long as you work hard, you can succeed.
items.translation_es: Con tal de que te esfuerces, puedes tener éxito.

items.translation_en: As long as you work hard, there is hope.
items.translation_es: Con tal de que te esfuerces, hay esperanza.

items.translation_en: As long as he agrees, I will go.
items.translation_es: Con tal de que él esté de acuerdo, iré.

items.translation_en: As long as I have time, I will come.
items.translation_es: Con tal de que tenga tiempo, vendré.

instruction: Drag 只有 or 才 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Only by working hard can you succeed.
Only he knows.
Only if you go will I go.
items.translation_es: Solo si tú vas, iré yo.

items.sentence: 只有多练习，___ 说得好。
items.translation_en: Only by practising a lot can you speak well.
items.translation_es: Solo practicando mucho se habla bien.

instruction: Drag 得 or 不 into each gap for a potential complement.

items.translation_en: I can finish eating it.
He cannot understand it.
Can you finish writing it?
We cannot walk any further.

instruction: Drag 把 into each gap for the disposal construction.

items.translation_en: I put the book on the table.
items.translation_es: Puse el libro sobre la mesa.

items.translation_en: He closed the door.
Please open the window.
She finished her homework.

instruction: Drag 被 into each gap for the passive.

items.translation_en: The book was taken away by him.
items.translation_es: El libro fue llevado por él.

items.translation_en: My car was stolen.
The window was blown open by the wind.
He was criticised by the teacher.

instruction: Drag 是 into each gap for emphasis with 是…的.

items.translation_en: It was yesterday that I came.
It was by train that he went.
When was it that you came?
It was he who wrote this book.
items.translation_es: Fue él quien escribió este libro.

instruction: Drag 不是 into each gap for a rhetorical question.

items.translation_en: Aren't you Chinese?
Isn't this your book?
Hasn't he already left?
Don't you like tea?

instruction: Drag 无论 or 都 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Whether you go or not, I will go.
No matter how hard it is, I will try.
items.translation_es: No importa cuán difícil sea, lo intentaré.

items.sentence: ___ 下雨还是晴天，他都跑步。
items.translation_en: Whether it rains or is sunny, he runs.
items.translation_es: Llueva o haga sol, él corre.

items.sentence: 无论谁，___ 要遵守规则。
items.translation_en: Whoever it is must follow the rules.
items.translation_es: Quienquiera que sea debe seguir las reglas.

instruction: Drag 不但 or 而且 into each gap.

items.sentence: 他 ___ 会英语，而且会汉语。
items.translation_en: He knows not only English but also Chinese.
items.translation_es: Sabe no solo inglés sino también chino.

items.sentence: 这个菜不但好吃，___ 便宜。
items.translation_en: This dish is not only tasty but also cheap.
items.translation_es: Este plato no solo está rico sino que es barato.

items.translation_en: She is not only clever but also hard-working.
items.translation_es: Ella no solo es inteligente sino también trabajadora.

items.sentence: 他不但是老师，___ 是作家。
items.translation_en: He is not only a teacher but also a writer.
items.translation_es: No solo es profesor sino también escritor.

instruction: Drag 即使 or 也 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Even if it rains, I will go.

items.sentence: 即使很累，我 ___ 要完成。
items.translation_en: Even if I am tired, I must finish.
Even if you disagree, I will do it.
items.translation_es: Aunque no estés de acuerdo, lo haré.

items.sentence: 即使他来了，___ 来不及了。
items.translation_en: Even if he comes, it will be too late.

instruction: Drag 既然 or 就 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Since you are here, let's eat together.
items.translation_es: Ya que estás aquí, comamos juntos.

items.sentence: 既然下雨，我们 ___ 在家吧。
items.translation_en: Since it is raining, let's stay at home.
items.translation_es: Ya que llueve, quedémonos en casa.

items.translation_en: Since you have decided, do not regret it.
items.translation_es: Ya que lo has decidido, no te arrepientas.

items.sentence: 既然你知道，___ 告诉我吧。
items.translation_en: Since you know, tell me.

instruction: Drag 尽管 or 还是 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Although he was busy, he still came.
Although it is hard, I will still try.
items.translation_es: Aunque es difícil, lo intentaré igualmente.

items.sentence: ___ 他不同意，我们还是做了。
items.translation_en: Although he disagreed, we still did it.
items.translation_es: Aunque él no estaba de acuerdo, lo hicimos igual.

items.sentence: 尽管下雨，他 ___ 出去了。
items.translation_en: Although it was raining, he still went out.

instruction: Drag 一 into each gap for 一…就.

items.translation_en: As soon as I get home, I go to sleep.
items.translation_es: En cuanto llego a casa, me duermo.

items.translation_en: As soon as he speaks, he laughs.
As soon as you look, you will understand.
items.translation_es: En cuanto lo mires, lo entenderás.

items.translation_en: As soon as it gets dark, we go home.
items.translation_es: En cuanto oscurece, volvemos a casa.

instruction: Drag 与其 or 不如 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Rather than wait at home, it is better to go out.
items.translation_es: En vez de esperar en casa, mejor salir a caminar.

items.sentence: 与其买新的，___ 修一下。
items.translation_en: Rather than buy a new one, it is better to repair it.
items.translation_es: En vez de comprar uno nuevo, mejor repararlo.

items.translation_en: Rather than complain, it is better to act.
items.translation_es: En vez de quejarse, mejor actuar.

items.sentence: 与其去电影院，我们 ___ 在家看。
items.translation_en: Rather than go to the cinema, we had better watch at home.
items.translation_es: En vez de ir al cine, mejor verlo en casa.

instruction: Drag 为了 into each gap.

items.translation_en: For the sake of his health, he runs every day.
items.translation_es: Por su salud, corre cada día.

items.sentence: 我 ___ 学中文来到中国。
items.translation_en: I came to China in order to learn Chinese.
items.translation_es: Vine a China para aprender chino.

items.translation_en: In order not to be late, he got up early.
items.translation_es: Para no llegar tarde, se levantó temprano.

items.translation_en: He works hard for his family.

instruction: Drag the directional complement into each gap.

items.translation_en: He stood up.
It gradually got dark.
Please bring the book over.
He ran out.

instruction: Drag 就是 into each gap.

items.translation_en: He does not want to go, it is just that he is too tired.
items.translation_es: No quiere ir, es solo que está muy cansado.

items.translation_en: This piece of clothing is nice, it is just too expensive.
items.translation_es: Esta prenda es bonita, solo que es cara.

items.sentence: 我不是不去，___ 没时间。
items.translation_en: It is not that I will not go, it is just that I have no time.
items.translation_es: No es que no vaya, es que no tengo tiempo.

items.sentence: 他人很好，___ 有点马虎。
items.translation_en: He is very nice, only a bit careless.
items.translation_es: Él es muy bueno, solo un poco descuidado.

instruction: Drag 连 into each gap.

items.sentence: 他 ___ 饭都没吃就走了。
items.translation_en: He left without even eating.

items.sentence: 这个字 ___ 老师都不认识。
items.translation_en: Even the teacher does not know this character.
items.translation_es: Ni siquiera el profesor conoce este carácter.

items.sentence: 他 ___ 自己的名字都不会写。
items.translation_en: He cannot even write his own name.
items.translation_es: Ni siquiera sabe escribir su propio nombre.

items.translation_en: I do not even have one penny.

instruction: Drag the correct tag question into each gap.

items.translation_en: You will come, all right?
Let's go, all right?
You are a teacher, right?
This book is good, isn't it?

instruction: Drag 与其 or 宁可 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Rather than ask others, I would rather solve it myself.
items.translation_es: Antes que pedir ayuda, prefiero resolverlo yo mismo.

items.translation_en: Rather than stay at home, he would rather go out.
items.translation_es: Antes que quedarse en casa, prefiere salir.

items.translation_en: Rather than wait, I would rather walk.

items.sentence: 与其买贵的，他 ___ 买实用的。
items.translation_en: Rather than buy something expensive, he would rather buy something practical.
items.translation_es: Antes que comprar algo caro, prefiere algo práctico.

instruction: Drag 固然 or 但是 into each gap.

items.sentence: 钱 ___ 重要，但是健康更重要。
items.translation_en: Money is certainly important, but health is more so.
items.translation_es: El dinero es ciertamente importante, pero la salud lo es más.

items.sentence: 固然很难，___ 值得一试。
items.translation_en: It is admittedly hard, but worth a try.
items.translation_es: Es ciertamente difícil, pero vale la pena intentarlo.

items.sentence: 他 ___ 聪明，但是不够努力。
items.translation_en: He is certainly clever, but not hard-working enough.
items.translation_es: Ciertamente es listo, pero no se esfuerza lo bastante.

items.sentence: 固然他错了，___ 你也有责任。
items.translation_en: Admittedly he was wrong, but you are also responsible.
items.translation_es: Ciertamente él se equivocó, pero tú también eres responsable.

instruction: Drag 尚且 or 何况 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Even he cannot do it, let alone me.
items.translation_es: Ni siquiera él sabe hacerlo, y mucho menos yo.

items.sentence: 这么难的问题，专家 ___ 解决不了，何况我们。
items.translation_en: Such a hard problem, even experts cannot solve it, let alone us.
items.translation_es: Un problema tan difícil, ni los expertos pueden resolverlo, y menos nosotros.

items.sentence: 他连饭 ___ 顾不上，何况休息。
items.translation_en: He cannot even find time to eat, let alone rest.
items.translation_es: Ni siquiera tiene tiempo para comer, y mucho menos para descansar.

items.sentence: 大人尚且做不到，___ 孩子？
items.translation_en: Even adults cannot do it, let alone children.
items.translation_es: Ni los adultos pueden hacerlo, y mucho menos los niños.

instruction: Drag 以免 or 免得 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Set off early so as to avoid being late.
items.translation_es: Sal temprano para evitar llegar tarde.

items.translation_en: Write it down so as not to forget.
Wear more so as to avoid catching a cold.
Be careful so as not to make a mistake.
items.translation_es: Ten cuidado para no cometer errores.

instruction: Drag 之所以 or 是因为 into each gap.

items.sentence: 他 ___ 成功，是因为他很努力。
items.translation_en: The reason he succeeded is that he worked very hard.
items.translation_es: La razón por la que tuvo éxito es que se esforzó mucho.

items.sentence: 之所以迟到，___ 路上堵车。
items.translation_en: The reason for being late is that there was a traffic jam.
items.translation_es: La razón de llegar tarde es que hubo un atasco.

items.sentence: 她 ___ 生气，是因为你没告诉她。
items.translation_en: The reason she is angry is that you did not tell her.
items.translation_es: La razón por la que está enfadada es que no se lo dijiste.

items.sentence: 之所以没去，___ 下雨了。
items.translation_en: The reason we did not go is that it rained.
items.translation_es: La razón de no ir es que llovió.

instruction: Drag 以至于 into each gap.

items.sentence: 他太累了，___ 站着就睡着了。
items.translation_en: He was so tired that he fell asleep standing up.
items.translation_es: Estaba tan cansado que se quedó dormido de pie.

items.sentence: 声音太大，___ 我听不见你说什么。
items.translation_en: The noise was so loud that I could not hear you.
items.translation_es: Había tanto ruido que no podía oírte.

items.sentence: 他跑得太快，___ 没人追得上。
items.translation_en: He ran so fast that no one could catch up.
items.translation_es: Corrió tan rápido que nadie pudo alcanzarlo.

items.sentence: 事情变化太快，___ 我们来不及反应。
items.translation_en: Things changed so fast that we had no time to react.
items.translation_es: Las cosas cambiaron tan rápido que no tuvimos tiempo de reaccionar.

instruction: Drag 反而 into each gap.

items.translation_en: He took the medicine, but the illness got worse instead.
items.translation_es: Tomó la medicina, pero la enfermedad empeoró.

items.sentence: 他不但没生气，___ 笑了。
items.translation_en: He did not get angry; on the contrary, he laughed.
items.translation_es: No se enfadó; al contrario, se rió.

items.translation_en: The more I sleep, the more tired I feel instead.
items.translation_es: Cuanto más duermo, más cansado estoy.

items.sentence: 我不但不累，___ 更精神了。
items.translation_en: I am not tired; on the contrary, I feel more energetic.
items.translation_es: No solo no estoy cansado, sino que estoy más animado.

instruction: Drag 未免 into each gap.

items.sentence: 你这样说 ___ 太过分了。
items.translation_en: Saying that is a bit too much.
items.translation_es: Decir eso es un poco excesivo.

items.translation_en: This price is rather too high.
He is rather too self-confident.
items.translation_es: Él es demasiado seguro de sí mismo.

items.sentence: 这样说 ___ 有点不公平。
items.translation_en: Saying that is somewhat unfair.
items.translation_es: Decir eso es un poco injusto.

instruction: Drag 不妨 into each gap.

items.translation_en: You might as well give it a try.

items.sentence: 如果不知道，___ 问问他。
items.translation_en: If you do not know, you might as well ask him.
items.translation_es: Si no lo sabes, bien podrías preguntarle.

items.translation_en: We might as well try another method.
We might as well listen to his opinion first.
items.translation_es: Bien podríamos escuchar su opinión primero.

instruction: Drag 难免 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Doing it for the first time, mistakes are unavoidable.
items.translation_es: Al hacerlo por primera vez, es inevitable equivocarse.

items.sentence: 人多的地方，___ 会有麻烦。
items.translation_en: In crowded places, trouble is inevitable.
items.translation_es: En lugares concurridos, los problemas son inevitables.

items.translation_en: He has just arrived, so it is natural he is not used to it.
items.translation_es: Acaba de llegar, es natural que no esté acostumbrado.

items.translation_en: Doing it this way will inevitably cause misunderstanding.

instruction: Drag 鉴于 into each gap.

items.sentence: ___ 情况紧急，我们必须马上行动。
items.translation_en: Given the urgency, we must act at once.
items.translation_es: Dada la urgencia, debemos actuar de inmediato.

items.sentence: ___ 他表现优秀，公司提拔了他。
items.translation_en: In view of his excellent performance, the company promoted him.
items.translation_es: En vista de su excelente rendimiento, la empresa lo ascendió.

items.translation_en: Owing to the weather, the event was cancelled.
items.translation_es: Debido al tiempo, el evento se canceló.

items.sentence: ___ 时间有限，我们就谈到这里。
items.translation_en: As time is limited, let us stop here.
items.translation_es: Como el tiempo es limitado, terminemos aquí.

instruction: Drag 便于 into each gap.

items.translation_en: Sort the files so that they are easy to find.
items.translation_es: Clasifica los archivos para que sea fácil encontrarlos.

items.translation_en: Please leave your phone number so that we can contact you.
items.translation_es: Por favor, deja tu teléfono para poder contactarte.

items.sentence: 建这个网站是 ___ 学习。
items.translation_en: This website was built to make studying easier.
items.translation_es: Este sitio web se creó para facilitar el estudio.

items.sentence: 把重点记下来，___ 复习。
items.translation_en: Note down the key points to make revision easier.

instruction: Drag 无非 into each gap.

items.sentence: 他这么说，___ 想让你高兴。
items.translation_en: He said that simply to please you.

items.sentence: 他生气，___ 是因为太累了。
items.translation_en: He is angry simply because he is too tired.
items.translation_es: Está enfadado simplemente porque está muy cansado.

items.translation_en: This is nothing but an excuse.
items.translation_es: Esto no es más que una excusa.

items.sentence: 我们争论，___ 为了解决问题。
items.translation_en: We argue simply in order to solve the problem.
items.translation_es: Discutimos simplemente para resolver el problema.

instruction: Drag 未尝 into each gap.

items.translation_en: This method is not necessarily unworkable.
items.translation_es: Este método no es necesariamente inviable.

items.translation_en: It is not that you cannot give it a try.
items.translation_es: No es que no puedas intentarlo.

items.sentence: 这样做 ___ 不是一种选择。
items.translation_en: Doing it this way is not necessarily not an option.
items.translation_es: Hacerlo así no deja de ser una opción.

items.sentence: 他的想法 ___ 没有道理。
items.translation_en: His idea is not without reason.
items.translation_es: Su idea no carece de razón.

instruction: Drag 何尝 into each gap.

items.translation_en: How could I not want to go?

items.sentence: 他 ___ 不愿意，只是没时间。
items.translation_en: It is not that he is unwilling, he simply has no time.
items.translation_es: No es que no quiera, simplemente no tiene tiempo.

items.sentence: 我们 ___ 不是这样想的？
items.translation_en: Haven't we thought the same way?
Have you never made an effort?

items.translation_en: As far as the price is concerned, this is cheap.
items.translation_es: En cuanto al precio, esto es barato.

items.sentence: 就能力 ___，他完全可以胜任。
items.translation_en: In terms of ability, he is fully capable.
items.translation_es: En cuanto a la capacidad, es totalmente competente.

items.sentence: ___ 质量而言，这个牌子最好。
items.translation_en: As far as quality is concerned, this brand is the best.
items.translation_es: En cuanto a la calidad, esta marca es la mejor.

items.translation_en: As far as I am concerned, I do not agree.
items.translation_es: En lo que a mí respecta, no estoy de acuerdo.
